title: Colles fracture: block, reduction and cast
stem: Plaster room. Mrs Wu, 65, fell on her outstretched right hand. Consent has been obtained for closed reduction. You have one assistant and a medical student. Interpret the X-ray, then demonstrate a haematoma block, reduction and cast on the model while teaching the student.

phases.title: X-ray and checks
phases.goal: Read the film; nerves before you start.

phases.title: Advice
phases.goal: Elevation, warning signs, follow-up, bone health.

review.text: Acceptable alignment. Your notes give radial shortening of 5 mm or less, and dorsal angulation of under 5° in one place and under 10° in another. Current thresholds (BOAST, AAOS): shortening 3 mm or less, dorsal tilt 10° or less, intra-articular step 2 mm or less.
Cast. Your notes suggest a long-arm cast first. A moulded below-elbow backslab is standard ED practice for a Colles fracture.

notes:
Checked against BOAST 'Management of distal radial fractures' (2017), AAOS 2020 guideline, and NICE NG38 (non-complex fractures).

Colles: extra-articular distal radius fracture with dorsal angulation, dorsal displacement, radial shortening ('dinner fork'). Check median nerve and EPL (thumb extension) before and after. Anaesthesia: haematoma block (1% lidocaine up to 10 mL, into the fracture haematoma from the dorsum, confirmed by aspirating blood) or Bier's block (IV regional; prilocaine, needs trained staff and a double cuff) or sedation. Reduction: traction with counter-traction to disimpact, then the distal fragment pushed volarly and into ulnar deviation. Below-elbow moulded backslab (three-point moulding); elevate. Repeat X-ray. Acceptable alignment (AAOS/BOAST): radial shortening 3 mm or less, dorsal tilt 10° or less, intra-articular step 2 mm or less; the older patient's function matters more than the film.

Your notes: acceptable radial shortening '5 mm or less' and dorsal angulation '<5°' (in one place) or '<10° dorsally' (in another); current thresholds are 3 mm and 10°. Your notes also suggest a long-arm cast first; a moulded below-elbow backslab is standard in UK/HK ED practice for Colles. The block and sedation steps match.

X-ray.r: Extra-articular distal radius fracture 2 cm from the joint with dorsal angulation and displacement, radial shortening; ulnar styloid fracture.

steps.label: Pre-procedure checks
steps.hint: Median nerve, EPL, circulation, skin, allergies.

Checks.t: Median nerve sensation and thumb abduction
Radial pulse and capillary refill; skin intact?

steps.label: Haematoma block
steps.hint: Clean, dorsal approach into the fracture, aspirate blood, inject lidocaine, wait.

opts.t: Clean the dorsum of the wrist with chlorhexidine
Insert the needle dorsally into the fracture site (radius, not the carpus)
opts.mark: Correct site: into the radial fracture

opts.t: Aspirate dark blood from the haematoma to confirm position
Inject 1% lidocaine up to 10 mL slowly

opts.mark: Waits for the block to work

opts.r: 400 mg is well above the maximum dose (3 mg/kg plain): risk of LA toxicity.

steps.label: Reduce and cast
steps.hint: Counter-traction, disimpact, reduce volarly and ulnarly, mould a below-elbow backslab, check.

opts.t: Assistant holds counter-traction at the elbow
Longitudinal traction, briefly exaggerate the deformity to disimpact
Push the distal fragment volarly and into ulnar deviation
opts.mark: Reduces with volar and ulnar pressure

opts.t: Apply a padded below-elbow dorsal backslab while traction is held
opts.mark: Applies a backslab while maintaining reduction

opts.t: Three-point mould with the heels of the hands; wrist slightly flexed and ulnar deviated

opts.r: Check X-ray shows restored volar tilt and length.

opts.t: Wrap a full circumferential plaster tightly on day one
opts.r: Swelling in the first days: use a backslab to avoid compartment syndrome.

steps.label: Discharge advice
steps.hint: Elevation, finger exercises, cast care, warning signs, fracture clinic.

opts.t: Elevate, move your fingers, keep the plaster dry; come back at once for severe pain, numb or blue fingers; fracture clinic in 1 week with an X-ray
opts.tz: 隻手要舉高，郁吓啲手指，石膏要保持乾爽。如果好痛、手指麻痺或者變藍，要即刻返嚟。一個禮拜後去骨科門診，照 X 光。
